THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES04 / 18
04
A CONSISTENT BRAND ANCHOR

One clear anchor.
The right color version.

Select the logo by its background first, then place it on the format grid. Transparent yellow logo belongs on Brand Green only; transparent green logo belongs on Brand Gold only. Keep the brand anchor consistent within each template.

THE VISUAL GUIDE

Find the logo anchor in every format.

Yellow logo anchor (#39823C canvas) Green logo anchor (#F3CB2D canvas) Safe region · Starting dimensions; verify final platform crops.

¼ × symbol width
PROPOSED CLEAR-SPACE RULE
LET THE MARK BREATHE

Space is part
of the signature.

The boundary is an exclusion zone, not a border to export. Measure from the visible mark, and review the complete lockup at the intended size.

01

Choose the surface first

Use only #39823C behind the yellow logo and #F3CB2D behind the green logo.

02

Exact digital sizes

Desktop header: 44 px height (33 px width). Mobile header / app bar: 36 px height (27 px width). Digital web banners & app banners (1080 × 600 px): 110 × 145 px mark (48 px inset). OG share cards (1200 × 630 px): 115 × 152 px mark (64 px inset).

03

Clear space

Proposed minimum: 0.25 × the symbol width on each side. Measure from the visible mark rather than empty SVG canvas.

04

Minimum size

Absolute minimum 32 px symbol height for compact digital UI and 64 px or larger for digital campaign layouts.

05

Responsive placement

Recompose the layout for narrow screens. Preserve the symbol aspect ratio, readable size and clear space; never stretch the image to fill a container.
